effect_unit_note: Large replicated fragmentation experiment; flowering increased with distance from habitat edge for all five species. Raw Dryad file is available at plant/structure level with block, patch, distance and species; effect must retain block/patch/species structure rather than treat plant rows as independent landscape replicates.
source_location: Hulting et al. 2025 main text; Dryad 10.5061/dryad.bnzs7h4mb
extraction_notes: Hurdle mixed model; extract species-specific model contrasts or reanalyse raw Dryad data with original block/patch hierarchy.

effect_unit_note: All species produced more flowering structures farther from edge; connectivity/edge-to-area effects were inconsistent among species. Preserve species-specific effects.
extraction_notes: Do not average species before extracting the original model coefficients.

effect_unit_note: Connectivity and distance from an edge had no detected effect on pollination rate for either wind- or insect-pollinated species. This is a legitimate layer-specific null but requires model coefficient/SE or raw reanalysis before quantitative meta-effect admission.
extraction_notes: Do not code nonsignificance as effect=0. Extract estimates and uncertainty.

effect_unit_note: Seed production increased farther from edge for four of five species, driven by flowering rather than pollination. Raw Dryad rows contain viable/nonviable seeds and reproductive/flowering variables but are nested within plant, patch and block.
source_location: Hulting et al. 2025 Figure 3; Dryad archive_SRS_2009_seeds.csv
extraction_notes: High-value NEE-Q1 empirical contrast: D and F respond to edge while I does not. Quantitative extraction pending raw/model coefficients; one species (Liatris) lacked the seed-production edge response.
